tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search verified Common Room venues in Hong Kong by type, with optional district, date, number of people and budget. Types offered: hourly_hotel = Hourly hotels / 時鐘酒店; party_room = Party Rooms in Hong Kong / Party Room 香港; event_venue = Event Venue Hong Kong / 場地租用 (商業) 香港; restaurant_private_room =

tools.name: get_venue_details
tools.description: Full public details of one verified venue: description, capacity, prices, facilities, extras, address and booking page link.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open start times and prices for an hourly hotel on a date within the next 13 days, grouped by length of stay (2, 3, 6 hours or overnight). For other venues it returns the booking page, which shows open times.
